description:
Reid Firetrail 2 | Gravel bike

Lightweight, capable and built for adventure – the ideal gravel bike for exploring off-road trails, taking on cyclocross, heading out on bikepacking trips or upgrading your daily commute.

The Reid Bikes Firetrail 2 builds on the versatility and value of the Firetrail 1, with upgraded components designed to deliver greater control and performance across a variety of terrain. Combining a lightweight aluminium frame with a carbon fibre fork, simplified gearing and hydraulic disc brakes, it's an excellent choice for riders looking to take their gravel riding further without stretching their budget.

Its aluminium frame is engineered to balance low weight and stiffness, providing responsive handling and reliable control on both paved roads and off-road routes. A lightweight bladed carbon fibre fork with a thru-axle design adds stability and precision, while clearance for tyres up to 45c gives you the flexibility to fit wider tyres for additional grip and comfort on rougher surfaces. The bike comes equipped with Kenda 40C tyres, offering a versatile setup for gravel tracks, cycle paths and everyday road riding.

A 1x10 drivetrain with LTWOO integrated shifters and a wide-range 11–46T cassette simplifies gear changes while providing plenty of range for tackling climbs, fast flat sections and varied terrain. The single-chainring setup also reduces complexity and helps minimise chain movement over rough ground. Tektro hydraulic disc brakes deliver powerful, controlled stopping with less effort at the levers, giving you added confidence when riding in wet weather or navigating technical descents.

Designed for everyday practicality as well as adventure, the Reid Bikes Firetrail 2 features mounts for a rear rack, mudguards and additional equipment, making it easy to customise for commuting, bikepacking and longer rides. An all-day comfortable saddle and quality Reid bar tape help keep you comfortable over extended distances, whether you're tackling a gravel route or spending hours in the saddle.

With its upgraded specification, versatile frame and adventure-ready features, the Reid Firetrail 2 offers an impressive balance of performance and value. From weekday commutes to weekend gravel rides and multi-day adventures, it's built to help you explore further with confidence.

The Reid Bikes Firetrail 2 is ideal for:

Gravel riding and off-road exploration, with a lightweight aluminium frame and versatile Kenda 40C tyres for mixed terrain

Everyday commuting, with responsive handling and practical mounts for accessories to suit your daily journey

Cyclocross and varied terrain, with a capable frame, carbon fibre fork and clearance for tyres up to 45c

Bikepacking and longer adventures, with rack, mudguard and equipment mounts for carrying luggage and essential gear

Riders tackling hills and challenging routes, with a 1x10 drivetrain and wide-range 11–46T cassette

Simple, reliable gear changes, with LTWOO integrated shifters and a single-chainring setup to reduce drivetrain complexity

Confident all-weather braking, with hydraulic disc brakes for powerful, controlled stopping in changing conditions

Comfort on longer rides, with an all-day saddle, quality Reid bar tape and tyres suited to mixed surfaces

Riders looking for an upgraded first gravel bike, combining a carbon fibre fork, hydraulic disc brakes and versatile gearing at an accessible price
